comments.value: Veteran status wasn't linked to the age of the account. There were plenty of users that were around for years, even before the Steam release, that weren't Veteran status. So it's unclear what that status was meant to indicate (even though the word "veteran" implies longevity).

Veteran rank (and all ranks really) should NOT exist. The system did a lot of good in terms of getting the low hanging trolls out, but it did nothing for the more persistent and subtle, while simultaneously causing terrible and unnecessary harm in the form of elitism and segregation. My personal solution would be to improve the avatar rating system, create a score based on how many hide an avatar or block its users, and tie the safety settings to both of those. Something like “if avatar reputation + user reputation < 0, it’s malicious and should be disabled by default”. Of course both should start with a default minor positive value, and gradually increase with time and decrease with hide’s and blocks. Oh and they shouldn’t be so clearly displayed as “ranks”.

Veteran rank served absolutely no purpose, and most certainly wouldn't distinguish trust worthy people from crashers and trolls any more than the trusted rank already does. Even during the short period of the trust system beta, I saw multiple crashers with the veteran rank.

By your logic, after a few more months we'd simply need yet another "Veteran+1" rank to distinguish people, because everyone would have climbed to veteran by then. You can't just add a new rank every year.
@{5b0b06e952d6c72deb336627|full_name}: i disagree that hiding avatars should count against this as i myself disable people avatars plenty just to save my fps a bit in vr

@{5b9f6c965a3e1a116727dfa8|full_name}: Understandably, some simply try to save FPS, but some also specifically hide avatars which are noisome. Perhaps the impact should be minor compared to the rest, and only when your avatar is specifically blocked. Mostly just spitballing. Stuff like this is notoriously difficult to get right.

If Trusted was so easy to get. I would've been Trusted by now.
I agree way to easy to get, 200 hours and I was trusted, so idk feels like someone else deserves it more than me
I have 3400 hours in the game and a little disappointed because in a way I kinda deserve it I have made worlds avatars and yeah bring it back

Easy? I have been stuck on Known for more than 1000 hours, i have uploaded 14 avatars, have 400 friends, spent an eternity on public lobbies, the only thing that would get me to trusted is to upload a world now, but i have 0 knowledge on making them and 0 desire aswell.
They should remove ranks alltogether and leave 2, newbie and trusted, get everyone that have more than 300 hours on trusted side and stop this nonsence grind for ranks, leave newbie rank for safety, not sure how many times i have been almost crashed or harrassed by new users and visitors, most of the time i just block them, and thanks to safety settings i have their avatars disabled by default.
I may have been blocked, as everyone, and blocked a lot of people myself, but grinding into trusted should be ENOUGH.

Getting rewarded for the time and effort you put into making VRChat a better place, community leading, making worlds and avatars, getting promoted to Veteran and leading by example. Having the Veteran rank motivated the Trusted Users to be better people, to be good and get ranked up instead of just rotting infront of a mirror, to bring more good to VRC. Then coming back from a week in hospital to find you lot removed Veteran and Legendary ranks. It's disrespectful. You would know that Veteran users in a room were respectable people, that they did good for VRC, now it's just a sea of purple, where even the great Poiyomi is just Trusted User. Where you got a girl who got there by erping and friending hundreds of people or even these days - freaking 10 year old quest kids, next to avatar/world/shader/community creators in terms of reputation and rank. No, I spit on this decision. It wasn't broken, so why fix it. AND not even put it on any update notes. It's disrespected so many people, just more proof that VRC doesn't give a shit about it's clientbase.

Doesn't even need to be a veteran rank, but at least some slightly higher requirements for trusted rank. I got my trusted rank after only 70 hours of play time. Maybe at least add like a 200h time requirement?

details: Hi, Im Coral. I have been playing this game for quite some time and I feel as if getting Trusted User is too easy to get. I see people running around with loud avatars, laggy shaders and even crashes, basically not TRUSTED. When the veteran rank was in place it paid a little respect to the people who have been playing this game for months and even a year. The same people who have created worlds and even avatars for the game. These are the people who care about the game and have put some time into it. Veterans are people we trust because trusted users just arent trusted.
title: Bring Veteran Rank Back
